description: This source file appears to be a shell script that tests and demonstrates the integration of Git with Perforce (p4), specifically focusing on changing file types such as symlinks and regular files within a version-controlled environment.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a local Perforce server instance for testing.

methods.name: p4 client
methods.description: Creates or modifies a Perforce client workspace.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository using git-p4.

methods.name: git p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes from Git back to Perforce.

methods.name: p4 filelog
methods.description: Retrieves the changelog for a file in Perforce, used here to verify file types.
